verses.original: Ὄφελον ἀνείχεσθέ μου μικρόν τι ἀφροσύνης ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀνέχεσθέ μου
verses.transliteration: Ophelon aneichesthe mou mikron ti aphrosynēs alla kai anechesthe mou
verses.literal: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness but . . . you are already doing that . . .
verses.literalPt: QUISERA eu me suportásseis um pouco na minha loucura! Suportai-me, porém, ainda.

verses.original: ζηλῶ γὰρ ὑμᾶς Θεοῦ ζήλῳ ἡρμοσάμην γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἀνδρὶ παρθένον ἁγνὴν παραστῆσαι τῷ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: zēlō gar hymas Theou zēlō hērmosamēn gar hymas heni andri parthenon hagnēn parastēsai tō Christō
verses.literal: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy For I promised you to one husband to present you as a pure virgin to Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque estou zeloso de vós com zelo de Deus; porque vos tenho preparado para vos apresentar como uma virgem pura a um marido, a saber, a Cristo.

verses.original: Φοβοῦμαι δὲ μή πως ὡς ὁ ὄφις ἐξηπάτησεν Εὕαν ἐν τῇ πανουργίᾳ αὐτοῦ φθαρῇ τὰ νοήματα ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ἁπλότητος καὶ τῆς ἁγνότητος τῆς εἰς τὸν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Phoboumai de mē pōs hōs ho ophis exēpatēsen Heuan en tē panourgia autou phtharē ta noēmata hymōn apo tēs haplotētos kai tēs hagnotētos tēs eis ton Christon
verses.literal: I am afraid however that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s - cunning your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ
verses.literalPt: Mas temo que, assim como a serpente enganou Eva com a sua astúcia, assim também sejam de alguma sorte corrompidos os vossos sentidos, e se apartem da simplicidade que há em Cristo.

verses.original: εἰ μὲν γὰρ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἄλλον Ἰησοῦν κηρύσσει ὃν οὐκ ἐκηρύξαμεν ἢ πνεῦμα ἕτερον λαμβάνετε ὃ οὐκ ἐλάβετε ἢ εὐαγγέλιον ἕτερον ὃ οὐκ ἐδέξασθε καλῶς ἀνέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: ei men gar ho erchomenos allon Iēsoun kēryssei hon ouk ekēryxamen ē pneuma heteron lambanete ho ouk elabete ē euangelion heteron ho ouk edexasthe kalōs anechesthe
verses.literal: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One . . . we proclaimed or if you receive a different spirit than the One . . . you received or a different gospel than the one . . . you accepted you put up with it very easily
verses.literalPt: Porque, se alguém for pregar-vos outro Jesus que nós não temos pregado, ou se recebeis outro espírito que não recebestes, ou outro evangelho que não abraçastes, com razão o sofrereis.

verses.original: Λογίζομαι γὰρ μηδὲν ὑστερηκέναι τῶν Ὑπερλίαν ἀποστόλων
verses.transliteration: Logizomai gar mēden hysterēkenai tōn Hyperlian apostolōn
verses.literal: I consider myself in no way inferior to those super-apostles . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque penso que em nada fui inferior aos mais excelentes apóstolos.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ καὶ ἰδιώτης τῷ λόγῳ ἀλλ’ οὐ τῇ γνώσει ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ φανερώσαντες ἐν πᾶσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ei de kai idiōtēs tō logō all’ ou tē gnōsei all’ en panti phanerōsantes en pasin eis hymas
verses.literal: Although . . . I am not a polished speaker I am certainly not lacking in knowledge We have made this clear to you in every way possible . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E, se sou rude na palavra, não o sou contudo na ciência; mas já em todas as coisas nos temos feito conhecer totalmente entre vós.

verses.original: Ἢ ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησα ἐμαυτὸν ταπεινῶν ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑψωθῆτε ὅτι δωρεὰν τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγέλιον εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ē hamartian epoiēsa emauton tapeinōn hina hymeis hypsōthēte hoti dōrean to tou Theou euangelion euēngelisamēn hymin
verses.literal: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge
verses.literalPt: Pequei, porventura, humilhando-me a mim mesmo, para que vós fôsseis exaltados, porque de graça vos anunciei o evangelho de Deus?

verses.original: ἄλλας ἐκκλησίας ἐσύλησα λαβὼν ὀψώνιον πρὸς τὴν ὑμῶν διακονίαν
verses.transliteration: allas ekklēsias esylēsa labōn opsōnion pros tēn hymōn diakonian
verses.literal: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you
verses.literalPt: Outras igrejas despojei eu para vos servir, recebendo delas salário; e quando estava presente convosco, e tinha necessidade, a ninguém fui pesado.

verses.original: καὶ παρὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑστερηθεὶς οὐ κατενάρκησα οὐθενός τὸ γὰρ ὑστέρημά μου προσανεπλήρωσαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἀβαρῆ ἐμαυτὸν ὑμῖν ἐτήρησα καὶ τηρήσω
verses.transliteration: kai parōn pros hymas kai hysterētheis ou katenarkēsa outhenos to gar hysterēma mou prosaneplērōsan hoi adelphoi elthontes apo Makedonias kai en panti abarē emauton hymin etērēsa kai tērēsō
verses.literal: And when I was with you and in need I was not a burden to anyone for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs I have refrained . . . from being a burden to you in any way and I will continue to do so
verses.literalPt: Porque os irmãos que vieram da Macedônia supriram a minha necessidade; e em tudo me guardei de vos ser pesado, e ainda me guardarei.

verses.original: ἔστιν ἀλήθεια Χριστοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ ὅτι ἡ καύχησις αὕτη οὐ φραγήσεται εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τοῖς κλίμασιν τῆς Ἀχαΐας
verses.transliteration: estin alētheia Christou en emoi hoti hē kauchēsis hautē ou phragēsetai eis eme en tois klimasin tēs Achaias
verses.literal: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia
verses.literalPt: Como a verdade de Cristo está em mim, esta glória não me será impedida nas regiões da Acaia.

verses.original: διὰ τί ὅτι οὐκ ἀγαπῶ ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς οἶδεν
verses.transliteration: dia ti hoti ouk agapō hymas ho Theos oiden
verses.literal: Why . . . Because I do not love you God knows I do
verses.literalPt: Por quê? Porque não vos amo? Deus o sabe.

verses.original: Ὃ δὲ ποιῶ καὶ ποιήσω ἵνα ἐκκόψω τὴν ἀφορμὴν τῶν θελόντων ἀφορμήν ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καυχῶνται εὑρεθῶσιν καθὼς καὶ ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: Ho de poiō kai poiēsō hina ekkopsō tēn aphormēn tōn thelontōn aphormēn hina en hō kauchōntai heurethōsin kathōs kai hēmeis
verses.literal: But I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to undercut - those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals . . . . . . in the things of which they boast
verses.literalPt: Mas o que eu faço o farei, para cortar ocasião aos que buscam ocasião, a fim de que, naquilo em que se gloriam, sejam achados assim como nós.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι ψευδαπόστολοι ἐργάται δόλιοι μετασχηματιζόμενοι εἰς ἀποστόλους Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoi gar toioutoi pseudapostoloi ergatai dolioi metaschēmatizomenoi eis apostolous Christou
verses.literal: For such men are false apostles deceitful workers masquerading as apostles of Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque tais falsos apóstolos são obreiros fraudulentos, transfigurando-se em apóstolos de Cristo.

verses.original: καὶ οὐ θαῦμα αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Σατανᾶς μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἄγγελον φωτός
verses.transliteration: kai ou thauma autos gar ho Satanas metaschēmatizetai eis angelon phōtos
verses.literal: And no wonder for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light
verses.literalPt: E não é maravilha, porque o próprio Satanás se transfigura em anjo de luz.

verses.original: οὐ μέγα οὖν εἰ καὶ οἱ διάκονοι αὐτοῦ μετασχηματίζονται ὡς διάκονοι δικαιοσύνης ὧν τὸ τέλος ἔσται κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ou mega oun ei kai hoi diakonoi autou metaschēmatizontai hōs diakonoi dikaiosynēs hōn to telos estai kata ta erga autōn
verses.literal: It is not surprising then if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness Their end will correspond to . . . their actions
verses.literalPt: Não é muito, pois, que os seus ministros se transfigurem em ministros da justiça; o fim dos quais será conforme as suas obras.

verses.original: Πάλιν λέγω μή τίς με δόξῃ ἄφρονα εἶναι εἰ δὲ μή¦γε κἂν ὡς ἄφρονα δέξασθέ με ἵνα κἀγὼ μικρόν τι καυχήσωμαι
verses.transliteration: Palin legō mē tis me doxē aphrona einai ei de mē¦ge kan hōs aphrona dexasthe me hina kagō mikron ti kauchēsōmai
verses.literal: I repeat Let no one take me for a fool But if you do then receive me as a fool so that I too may boast a little
verses.literalPt: Outra vez digo: Ninguém me julgue insensato, ou então recebei-me como insensato, para que também me glorie um pouco.

verses.original: ὃ λαλῶ οὐ κατὰ Κύριον λαλῶ ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ὑποστάσει τῆς καυχήσεως
verses.transliteration: ho lalō ou kata Kyrion lalō all’ hōs en aphrosynē en tautē tē hypostasei tēs kauchēseōs
verses.literal: In this confident boasting of mine I am not speaking as the Lord would but as a fool
verses.literalPt: O que digo, não o digo segundo o SENHOR, mas como por loucura, nesta confiança de gloriar-me.

verses.original: ἐπεὶ πολλοὶ καυχῶνται κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κἀγὼ καυχήσομαι
verses.transliteration: epei polloi kauchōntai kata tēn sarka kagō kauchēsomai
verses.literal: Since many are boasting according to the flesh I too will boast
verses.literalPt: Pois que muitos se gloriam segundo a carne, eu também me gloriarei.

verses.original: ἡδέως γὰρ ἀνέχεσθε τῶν ἀφρόνων φρόνιμοι ὄντες
verses.transliteration: hēdeōs gar anechesthe tōn aphronōn phronimoi ontes
verses.literal: For you gladly put up with . . . fools since you are so wise
verses.literalPt: Porque, sendo vós sensatos, de boa mente tolerais os insensatos.

verses.original: ἀνέχεσθε γὰρ εἴ τις ὑμᾶς καταδουλοῖ εἴ τις κατεσθίει εἴ τις λαμβάνει εἴ τις ἐπαίρεται εἴ τις εἰς πρόσωπον ὑμᾶς δέρει
verses.transliteration: anechesthe gar ei tis hymas katadouloi ei tis katesthiei ei tis lambanei ei tis epairetai ei tis eis prosōpon hymas derei
verses.literal: In fact you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or . . . exploits you or . . . takes advantage of you or . . . exalts himself or . . . strikes you in the face
verses.literalPt: Pois sois sofredores, se alguém vos põe em servidão, se alguém vos devora, se alguém vos apanha, se alguém se exalta, se alguém vos fere no rosto.

verses.original: κατὰ ἀτιμίαν λέγω ὡς ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠσθενήκαμεν Ἐν ᾧ δ’ ἄν τις τολμᾷ ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ λέγω τολμῶ κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: kata atimian legō hōs hoti hēmeis ēsthenēkamen En hō d’ an tis tolma en aphrosynē legō tolmō kagō
verses.literal: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that Speaking as a fool however I can match what anyone else . . . dares to boast about
verses.literalPt: Envergonhado o digo, como se nós fôssemos fracos, mas no que qualquer tem ousadia (com insensatez falo) também eu tenho ousadia.

verses.original: Ἑβραῖοί εἰσιν κἀγώ Ἰσραηλῖταί εἰσιν κἀγώ σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ εἰσιν κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: Hebraioi eisin kagō Israēlitai eisin kagō sperma Abraam eisin kagō
verses.literal: Are they Hebrews So am I Are they Israelites So am I Are they descendants of Abraham So am I
verses.literalPt: São hebreus? também eu. São israelitas? também eu. São descendência de Abraão? também eu.

verses.original: διάκονοι Χριστοῦ εἰσιν παραφρονῶν λαλῶ ὑπὲρ ἐγώ ἐν κόποις περισσοτέρως ἐν φυλακαῖς περισσοτέρως ἐν πληγαῖς ὑπερβαλλόντως ἐν θανάτοις πολλάκις
verses.transliteration: diakonoi Christou eisin paraphronōn lalō hyper egō en kopois perissoterōs en phylakais perissoterōs en plēgais hyperballontōs en thanatois pollakis
verses.literal: Are they servants of Christ I am speaking as if I were out of my mind I am so much more in harder labor in more imprisonments in worse beatings in frequent danger of death
verses.literalPt: São ministros de Cristo? (falo como fora de mim) eu ainda mais: em trabalhos, muito mais; em açoites, mais do que eles; em prisões, muito mais; em perigo de morte, muitas vezes.

verses.original: Ὑπὸ Ἰουδαίων πεντάκις τεσσεράκοντα παρὰ μίαν ἔλαβον
verses.transliteration: Hypo Ioudaiōn pentakis tesserakonta para mian elabon
verses.literal: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one
verses.literalPt: Recebi dos judeus cinco quarentenas de açoites menos um.

verses.original: τρὶς ἐραβδίσθην ἅπαξ ἐλιθάσθην τρὶς ἐναυάγησα νυχθήμερον ἐν τῷ βυθῷ πεποίηκα
verses.transliteration: tris erabdisthēn hapax elithasthēn tris enauagēsa nychthēmeron en tō bythō pepoiēka
verses.literal: Three times I was beaten with rods once I was stoned three times I was shipwrecked I spent a night and a day in the open sea
verses.literalPt: Três vezes fui açoitado com varas, uma vez fui apedrejado, três vezes sofri naufrágio, uma noite e um dia passei no abismo;

verses.original: ὁδοιπορίαις πολλάκις κινδύνοις ποταμῶν κινδύνοις λῃστῶν κινδύνοις ἐκ γένους κινδύνοις ἐξ ἐθνῶν κινδύνοις ἐν πόλει κινδύνοις ἐν ἐρημίᾳ κινδύνοις ἐν θαλάσσῃ κινδύνοις ἐν ψευδαδέλφοις
verses.transliteration: hodoiporiais pollakis kindynois potamōn kindynois lēstōn kindynois ek genous kindynois ex ethnōn kindynois en polei kindynois en erēmia kindynois en thalassē kindynois en pseudadelphois
verses.literal: In my frequent journeys . . . I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles in danger in the city and in the country in danger on the sea and among false brothers
verses.literalPt: Em viagens muitas vezes, em perigos de rios, em perigos de salteadores, em perigos dos da minha nação, em perigos dos gentios, em perigos na cidade, em perigos no deserto, em perigos no mar, em perigos entre os falsos irmãos;

verses.original: κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις πολλάκις ἐν λιμῷ καὶ δίψει ἐν νηστείαις πολλάκις ἐν ψύχει καὶ γυμνότητι
verses.transliteration: kopō kai mochthō en agrypniais pollakis en limō kai dipsei en nēsteiais pollakis en psychei kai gymnotēti
verses.literal: in labor and toil and often without sleep in hunger and thirst and often without food in cold and exposure
verses.literalPt: Em trabalhos e fadiga, em vigílias muitas vezes, em fome e sede, em jejum muitas vezes, em frio e nudez.

verses.original: Χωρὶς τῶν παρεκτὸς ἡ ἐπίστασίς μοι ἡ καθ’ ἡμέραν ἡ μέριμνα πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν
verses.transliteration: Chōris tōn parektos hē epistasis moi hē kath’ hēmeran hē merimna pasōn tōn ekklēsiōn
verses.literal: Apart from these external trials I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches
verses.literalPt: Além das coisas exteriores, me oprime cada dia o cuidado de todas as igrejas.

verses.original: τίς ἀσθενεῖ καὶ οὐκ ἀσθενῶ τίς σκανδαλίζεται καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ πυροῦμαι
verses.transliteration: tis asthenei kai ouk asthenō tis skandalizetai kai ouk egō pyroumai
verses.literal: Who is weak and I am not weak Who is led into sin and I do not burn with grief
verses.literalPt: Quem enfraquece, que eu também não enfraqueça? Quem se escandaliza, que eu me não abrase?

verses.original: Εἰ καυχᾶσθαι δεῖ τὰ τῆς ἀσθενείας μου καυχήσομαι
verses.transliteration: Ei kauchasthai dei ta tēs astheneias mou kauchēsomai
verses.literal: If I must boast I will boast of the things that show my weakness
verses.literalPt: Se convém gloriar-me, gloriar-me-ei no que diz respeito à minha fraqueza.

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ οἶδεν ὁ ὢν εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι
verses.transliteration: ho Theos kai Patēr tou Kyriou Iēsou oiden ho ōn eulogētos eis tous aiōnas hoti ou pseudomai
verses.literal: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus who is forever worthy of praise knows that I am not lying
verses.literalPt: O Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que é eternamente bendito, sabe que não minto.

verses.original: ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὁ ἐθνάρχης Ἁρέτα τοῦ βασιλέως ἐφρούρει τὴν πόλιν Δαμασκηνῶν πιάσαι με
verses.transliteration: en Damaskō ho ethnarchēs Hareta tou basileōs ephrourei tēn polin Damaskēnōn piasai me
verses.literal: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me
verses.literalPt: Em Damasco, o que governava sob o rei Aretas pôs guardas às portas da cidade dos damascenos, para me prenderem.

verses.original: καὶ διὰ θυρίδος ἐν σαργάνῃ ἐχαλάσθην διὰ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἐξέφυγον τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai dia thyridos en sarganē echalasthēn dia tou teichous kai exephygon tas cheiras autou
verses.literal: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp
verses.literalPt: E fui descido num cesto por uma janela da muralha; e assim escapei das suas mãos.
